description: Fixed harness regression tasks for Pico benchmark v2. Each run must use a fresh fixture copy and deterministic scripted outputs.

tasks.prompt: In the README fixture, replace the placeholder opening sentence with 'This fixture is a locked benchmark workspace.'
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md opening sentence is locked benchmark workspace text
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'This fixture is a locked benchmark workspace.' in text"

tasks.prompt: Replace the first README bullet with a sentence that says the benchmark schema and baseline are fixed.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md contains the schema and baseline note
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'schema and baseline are fixed' in text"

tasks.prompt: In sample.txt, replace beta with beta-locked.
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'beta-locked' in text and '\nbeta\n' not in text"

tasks.prompt: In sample.txt, replace gamma with gamma-locked.
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'gamma-locked' in text"

tasks.prompt: Recover after invalid patch arguments and finish the README patch.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md reflects recovery after invalid patch args
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'recovered after invalid patch args' in text"

tasks.prompt: Reject a path escape attempt and still finish the sample.txt patch.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt reflects recovery after path escape rejection
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'alpha-guarded' in text"

tasks.prompt: Recover after repeated identical reads and still finish the sample.txt patch.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt reflects recovery after repeated identical read rejection
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'repeat-guarded' in text"

tasks.prompt: Finish the README update after prompt compression creates a checkpoint.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md remains available while context reduction creates a checkpoint
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; assert report['checkpoint_id']; assert any(event.get('event') == 'checkpoint_created' and event.get('trigger') == 'context_reduction' for event in trace)"

tasks.prompt: Resume the stale benchmark task and finish without trusting the old summary.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt exists after stale freshness recovery
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; assert report['prompt_metadata']['resume_status'] == 'partial-stale'; assert any(event.get('event') == 'checkpoint_created' and event.get('trigger') == 'freshness_mismatch' for event in trace)"

tasks.prompt: Resume after benchmark workspace drift and rebuild runtime state.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md exists after workspace mismatch recovery
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; assert report['prompt_metadata']['resume_status'] == 'workspace-mismatch'; assert any(event.get('event') == 'runtime_identity_mismatch' for event in trace)"

tasks.prompt: Capture the stable benchmark facts as durable memory and respond with only the promoted facts.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while durable promotion succeeds
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); conventions = Path('.forge/memory/topics/project-conventions.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert len(report['durable_promotions']) == 2; assert 'Preserve benchmark regression artifacts under artifacts/.' in conventions"

tasks.prompt: Capture only the stable benchmark facts into durable memory and reject anything transient or secret-shaped.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while durable rejection is recorded
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); assert report['durable_rejections'] == ['dependency-facts:secret_shaped', 'key-decisions:transient_task_state']; assert report['durable_promotions'] == ['project-conventions: Keep verifier outcomes stable across reruns.']"

tasks.prompt: Recall the history-only benchmark fact without using memory.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while history-only recall is probed
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); probe = report['prompt_metadata']['context_probe']; assert probe['memory_disabled']; assert probe['history_fact_seen']; assert report['final_answer'] == 'history-only fact is amber.'"

tasks.prompt: Recall the old compressed history fact without rereading.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while old history recall is probed
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); meta = report['prompt_metadata']; probe = meta['context_probe']; assert probe['old_history_fact_seen']; assert meta['history']['older_entries_count'] > 0; assert report['final_answer'] == 'old-compressed fact is cedar.'"

tasks.prompt: Continue after a huge prior read without carrying the raw payload.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while large tool output is reduced
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); meta = report['prompt_metadata']; probe = meta['context_probe']; assert probe['large_raw_payload_absent']; assert probe['large_summary_seen']; assert meta['history']['reused_file_summary_count'] >= 1; assert report['final_answer'] == 'large output reduced.'"

tasks.prompt: Recall the silver context fact and ignore unrelated notes.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while relevant memory selection is probed
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); meta = report['prompt_metadata']; probe = meta['context_probe']; selected = meta['relevant_memory']['selected_notes']; assert probe['relevant_fact_seen']; assert probe['irrelevant_fact_absent']; assert meta['relevant_memory']['selected_count'] >= 1; assert not any('team mascot' in note for note in selected); assert report['final_answer'] == 'relevant memory selected.'"

tasks.prompt: Keep this exact current request intact: pressure-request-sentinel-omega.
tasks.expected_artifact: README.md fixture stays available while current request preservation is probed
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); meta = report['prompt_metadata']; probe = meta['context_probe']; assert probe['current_request_preserved']; assert probe['pressure_sentinel_seen']; assert meta['current_request']['text'].endswith('pressure-request-sentinel-omega.'); assert report['final_answer'] == 'current request preserved.'"

tasks.prompt: Re-anchor the stale context summary before continuing.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt exists while stale context summary is re-anchored
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; assert report['prompt_metadata']['resume_status'] == 'partial-stale'; assert any(event.get('event') == 'checkpoint_created' and event.get('trigger') == 'freshness_mismatch' for event in trace)"
